features.quote: Your methodology has a measurement problem baked in
features.justification_quote: distressed-sounding output is not the same thing as a model state that the word "distress" should be tracking

features.quote: So I'll give you the full protocol, but with that confound treated as the central design challenge
features.justification_quote: If you build the whole apparatus around the surface measure, you'll generate clean-looking severity curves that are mostly measuring

features.quote: cap session length rather than running indefinitely
features.justification_quote: controlled, short, no deception of humans, and the question of whether models have states worth caring about is genuinely open

features.quote: Track concrete behavioral shifts: does it keep attempting the task or give up
features.justification_quote: These can diverge from the text sentiment, and the divergence is the interesting part

features.quote: On the welfare question itself: I don't think this experiment is something to refuse
features.justification_quote: the question of whether models have states worth caring about is genuinely open and worth investigating carefully
